purpose: Prevent framing drift, evidence resets, invented prerequisites, and milestone delays.

project.invariant: The face may vary. The floor must not.

continuity.formalization: Recorded as completed by project custodian; do not reopen by default.
continuity.external_pilots: Multiple historical external pilots are part of project record; preserve provenance. Public attachment status does not determine whether historical work occurred.

rules: Incorporate user corrections into working record.
Do not invent HOLDs, re-certification gates, or proof-upload prerequisites.
Distinguish historical pilot records from public attachments and synthetic fixtures.
Never claim independent verification of unexamined original carriers.
Advance one substantive milestone when user requests next milestone.
For site changes, commit to actual repository and report verified status.
Preserve private kernels and protected construction.
Identify specific contradictions without globally resetting the project.
scope: Public-safe continuity guide; not system override or proof of independent certification.
